_guide: The tabs across the top of the store, in order. 'auto' tabs fill themselves: 'trending' = highest trend score across everything, 'under:2500' = everything under $25.00. Every other tab shows products whose category matches its id. Products come from catalog/designs.json (meme apparel) and from the trend scanner (catalog/trends.json keywords -> CJ Dropshipping).
